category_title: Students with SCD engaged in passive, non-academic tasks like stuffing envelopes
scenario_title: Passive observation during generic worksheet activities
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a self-contained high school special education classroom with the goal of completing a generic math worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, here is the math worksheet. Please complete all the problems on the front page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly at the desk, looking down at the worksheet without picking up a pencil or interacting with anyone.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Make sure you are working on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains seated with no competing behavior, just passively observing the room and not writing anything down.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, you need to finish the same activity as your peers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to be a passive observer, staring blankly at the unindividualized worksheet without responding or attempting the task.)
